reply_text:
*Found one merge-blocking issue* in `leaderboard-sort` (`17941bc`) vs `main` (`93d02a4`).

*P1 — Incorrect ranking for large scores* — `src/rank.js:3`
The comparator `b.score - a.score` converts decimal strings to JavaScript Numbers, losing precision beyond 2^53 and violating the documented score contract.

Confirmed reproduction:
• Input: `lower: "9007199254740992"`, then `higher: "9007199254740993"`.
• `rankings()` incorrectly puts `lower` first.
• `topN(entries, 1)` consequently returns the wrong winner.

Use the existing `compareScore(b.score, a.score)` comparator and add regression coverage for both ranking and top-N with large scores.

All 3 existing tests pass, but the ranking test only uses small scores. No other confirmed issues found. *I’d hold the merge until this is fixed.* No code changed.
